title: Transforming Dutch: Debiasing Dutch Coreference Resolution Systems for Non-binary Pronouns

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a coreference resolution system's performance using the LEA metric and a custom 'pronoun score' on test sets that have been counterfactually modified to contain specific pronoun sets (masculine, feminine, gender-neutral, and neopronouns), alongside name anonymization and gender-neutral noun replacements to isolate the effect of the pronouns.
